title: Publication preparation, pilot protocol, and data-capture controls
purpose: Prepare and pilot a reproducible synthetic experiment pipeline without converting provisional mappings, parameters, or outputs into publication evidence.

research_questions.text: Within the declared abstract model, how do B0, B1, B2, and provisional T1 classify recovery outcomes under matched fault scenarios?
research_questions.publication_prerequisite: Equivalent scenario execution and metric capture must exist for every treatment.

research_questions.text: Within discrete contact windows, how do recovery duration, retry overhead, security state, and availability state vary across matched fault schedules?
research_questions.publication_prerequisite: Metric definitions, denominators, exclusions, and treatment parity must be frozen before the publication-candidate run.

research_questions.text: Where do bounded formal witnesses and Python execution traces agree or differ under the declared projection?
research_questions.publication_prerequisite: Any external statement must retain bounded-execution and projection qualifiers.

pilot_scope.label: PILOT_INTERNAL_VALIDATION_ONLY
pilot_scope.primary_goal: Validate T1 schedule generation, event capture, metrics, analysis handoff, provenance, checksum, exclusion, and rerun controls.
pilot_scope.baseline_activity: Run existing deterministic baseline regressions only; do not compare their counts directly with T1 seeded metrics.

inclusion_rules: Include every successfully parsed run produced from the exact recorded configuration and serialized schedule.
Include adverse, indeterminate, degraded, expired, locked, unsafe, divergent, and success outcomes without outcome-based filtering.
Retain zero-fault schedules generated by the declared seed process.
Retain low-count groups and label them descriptive-only.
exclusion_rules: Exclude only runs with documented technical execution failure, corrupted output, schema failure, checksum failure, or configuration mismatch.
Do not exclude a run because its outcome is unexpected, unfavorable, or inconvenient.
Record every exclusion with run ID, reason, evidence path, and disposition before aggregate interpretation.

rerun_policy.prohibited_reason: Rerunning solely to obtain a preferred outcome or aggregate result.
rerun_policy.preservation_rule: Preserve the original failed or superseded attempt and link it to the rerun record.
rerun_policy.comparison_rule: Do not combine pre-correction and post-correction runs in one aggregate unless the protocol explicitly defines a stratified analysis.

required_provenance: serialized schedules and schedule SHA-256 values
capture_requirements.raw_data_rule: Raw generated outputs are immutable after capture; corrections produce a new run directory.
capture_requirements.processed_data_rule: Every processed artifact must identify its source files, script, commit, and checksum.

publication_candidate_entry_gate: Pilot run and analysis pipeline reproduce from retained configuration and checksums.
Baseline B0, B1, and B2 runners provide metric definitions and capture parity with T1.
All treatment scenarios are matched or differences are explicitly justified.
Final seed, parameter, exclusion, denominator, threshold, and statistical-analysis decisions are versioned before viewing publication aggregates.
All open defects affecting scientific validity are closed or explicitly accepted as limitations.
The external-review status and unresolved claim boundaries are stated accurately.
